clips.title: The story
paras: In northern Tirisfal, Rot Hide gnolls carry a fluid that preserves their decaying bodies. The Forsaken Apothecaries seek to study it against the Scourge.

Rot Hide gnolls at Garren's Haunt and the nearby mass graves are rotting thralls sent by the Scourge to dig up plague victims. Embalming Ichor flows through their decayed veins, preserving their flesh and sustaining their unlife. Magistrate Sevren in Brill wants vials recovered from these grave robbers. The Royal Apothecary Society will use fresh specimens to study the fluid and seek ways to turn it against the Lich King's minions.
